name: FIDO Alliance agentic authentication and payments work
status: Announced 2026-04-28: an Agentic Authentication Technical Working Group, and work in the Payments Technical Working Group starting from Google (AP2) and Mastercard (Verifiable Intent) contributions.
relevance: The release says the Payments Technical Working Group is "chaired by members from Mastercard and Visa"; it says contributed, while the AP2 repository says its core specification has been donated to FIDO. For the Agentic Authentication Technical Working Group the release says it is "chaired by members from CVS Health, Google and OpenAI and vice-chaired by members from Amazon, Google and Okta" (read in a browser on 2026-10-14); it names companies, not persons.
